text: You did it! You won the Polar Explorer trophy!
Polar Explorer! From The Poles.
These are the Poles! The top and the bottom of the world.
The North Pole is a frozen ocean. The South Pole is a frozen land.
Polar bears live in the north, and penguins live in the south. They never meet!
When it's summer at the North Pole, it's winter at the South Pole.
At the poles, the sun stays up for months, then stays down for months.
Antarctica is the coldest, windiest place on Earth.
Most of an iceberg is hidden under the water.
Antarctica's ice holds most of the world's fresh water.
Nobody lives in Antarctica for good, but scientists work there together.
Polar bears have black skin under their white fur.
Arctic foxes turn white in winter and brown in summer.
Penguins slide on their tummies to go fast.
Emperor penguin dads keep the egg warm on their feet.
Narwhals have a long tooth that grows out like a unicorn horn!
Want to see real polar bear cubs on the ice?
Want to see foxes that turn white for winter?
Let's see penguins zoom out of the sea!
Let's see the penguin dads huddle!
Want to see a real iceberg break off?
Let's see narwhals, the unicorns of the sea!
